target.title: fix: ignore invalid Retry-After HTTP dates
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where provider calls could treat malformed `Retry-After` HTTP-date headers as far-future retry windows when the date parser normalized invalid calendar dates such as `31 Feb`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The guarded provider fetch path and the ChatGPT Responses retry path now parse RFC 1123, obsolete RFC 850, and asctime `Retry-After` HTTP dates by their components and verify the UTC date round trip before honoring the header. Numeric `Retry-After` values and valid obsolete RFC 850 dates keep their existing behavior, including the rolling 50-year two-digit-year window.

## User Impact

Malformed provider throttle headers no longer cause long retry sleeps or retry-bypass decisions. Valid HTTP-date `Retry-After` headers continue to work across the provider retry boundaries covered by this change.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: invalid calendar dates in `Retry-After` HTTP-date headers are ignored in both the guarded provider fetch path and the ChatGPT Responses retry sleep path, while valid obsolete RFC 850 years inside the 50-year window still resolve as future retry dates.
- Focused implementation proof at `6481c1c792e07cad2fa394d26e649eed2dc7ad4a`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts` passed with 2 Vitest shards, 29 `packages/ai` tests, and 91 `src/agents` tests.
- Current-head CI proof at `def9d3dcfce1bcee11cf6a4a38bebca8e4f5e07e`: `Real behavior proof`, `Scan changed paths (precise)`, `check-lint`, `check-test-types`, `check-prod-types`, `build-artifacts`, and the full CI check rollup passed; the previous `checks-node-compact-small-whole-2` timeout passed on the refreshed head.
- Current-head diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed after merging current `upstream/main`, and the PR three-dot diff remains limited to the four Retry-After source/test files.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed on the implementation commit with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: `Sun, 31 Feb 2027 00:00:00 GMT` and `Sunday, 31-Feb-27 00:00:00 GMT` are treated as malformed, and `Sunday, 06-Nov-50 00:00:00 GMT` resolves through the RFC 850 50-year future window.
- Provider-stub transcript at `def9d3dcfce1bcee11cf6a4a38bebca8e4f5e07e`:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose -t retry-after` passed: `26 passed | 65 skipped`; covered `buildGuardedModelFetch > long retry-after handling`, including `ignores invalid HTTP-date retry-after values: Sun, 31 Feb 2027 00:00:00 GMT`, `ignores invalid HTTP-date retry-after values: Sunday, 31-Feb-27 00:00:00 GMT`, and `interprets RFC 850 retry-after years within the 50-year future window`.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose -t Retry-After` passed: `6 passed | 23 skipped` for `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts`; covered `streamOpenAICodexResponses transport`, including both malformed February headers and `honors RFC 850 Retry-After years within the 50-year future window`.
